Definition: Kenaan, a son a Ham; also the country inhabited by him
BiblicalUsage: Canaan = "lowland"; n pr m; 1) the 4th son of Ham and the progenitor of the Phoenicians and of the various nations who peopled the seacoast of Palestine; n pr loc; 2) the land west of the Jordan peopled by the descendants of Canaan and subsequently conquered by the Israelites under Joshua; n m; 3) merchant, trader
